4) Banking details / remittance / 1099 info
   - Owner: Acme finance
   - Target date: 2026-03-24

5) PO issuance / payment terms finalized
   - Owner: Acme finance / legal
   - Target date: 2026-03-31 (target close date for procurement milestone)

Open items / dependencies:
- Signed MSA or PO (legal)
- Payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45)
- AP contact for Coupa vendor questions
- Any specific vendor form fields required by Coupa (e.g., tax ID format, remittance address)

Next actions for today:
- Lisa / Acme: confirm Coupa vs Ariba and AP contact for vendor creation (Ben?)
- Marissa: send the completed vendor form + W-9 (attached) and a brief guide to required fields for Coupa
- Rafael / Jonas (cc): standing by to help with contract/legal if any redlines surface

Hi Marissa — thanks for this and the clear plan. A few quick notes from our side:

- We are using Coupa (confirmed) — not Ariba. Please update the MAP to reflect Coupa.
- AP owner for vendor creation is Ben Carter (ben.carter@acme.com). He will create the vendor record in Coupa.
- Our typical timeline is vendor creation + validation within 5-7 business days after we receive a completed vendor form + W-9.
- Required fields in Coupa: legal entity name, EIN, remittance address, payment type (ACH/wire), banking routing/account (if ACH), tax classification. If you can pre-populate those in the vendor form it speeds things up.

Ben, looping you in — can you confirm you can start vendor creation the week of Mar 15 if Marissa provides the completed form by Mar 12?

I’ll review the attached W-9 and MAP and get back with any questions.

Best,
